verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents a public API in depth. It covers API credential generation with permissions, reference endpoints for customers, monitoring, cases, audit trails, exports, transactions and IAM roles, plus rate-limit headers, a versioning policy, and a Postman collection with a downloadable OpenAPI schema. A probe retrieved and parsed an OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema covering these resources; the 404s at other guessed paths do not contradict this. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of an authenticated API operation actually executing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
